title: Crystal Shawanda - Would You Know Love

lines.l: Be with another girl
Making it all look so real
You held her love in the palm of your head
But do you really know
Or just how it feels
Would you know, love, if it knocked upon your door? Would you leave it closed just like you did before?
Would you know, love, if it looked you in the eye?
Would you just stand there and let it slip, slip on down?
You had me, darling, a long time ago
But you were searching all the while
I walked away
And kept my pride
While you're still hung up on dreams
That you hold so high
Would you know, love
If it knocked upon your door
Would you leave me closed just like you did before?
Would you, oh, love, if it locked you in the eye?
Would you just stand there and let it slip, slip on by?
